events.verdict: Castle (SAS) brings his hand forward towards the ball, and the contact with Garland's (CLE) lower body during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Paul (SAS) overtly, and abruptly, brings his left arm up into Garland (CLE) and hooks his left arm, which affects his ability to defend.
Correctly called Delay of Game violation.
Mobley (CLE) firms up over his left foot in Castle's (SAS) path and absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Castle (SAS) moves towards Mitchell (CLE) and the contact as Mitchell passes the ball is marginal.

events.verdict: Mobley (CLE) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Spurs.
Champagnie (SAS) jumps alongside Garland's (CLE) path and avoids making contact with his left arm as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Champagnie (SAS) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Mitchell (CLE) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Spurs.
Hunter (CLE) is moving alongside Paul's (SAS) path, and the contact as they come together during the drive is marginal.
Vassell (SAS) brings his right arm forward towards Mitchell's (CLE) front, and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Barnes (SAS) is retreating his left arm into a vertical position and the contact that occurs with Mitchell's (CLE) arm during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Paul (SAS) raises his right hand directly into the ball and cleanly blocks Mitchell's (CLE) driving shot attempt.
Champagnie (SAS) legally contests Garland's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Garland's (CLE) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim prior to the expiration of the shot clock.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Spurs.
Strus (CLE) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact created by Barnes (SAS) as he brings his left arm towards Strus' upper body during the shot attempt.
